provenance: Real response, recorded 2026-11-10: GET https://metadata.provider.plex.tv/library/metadata/5d7768ba96b655001fdc0408?includeGuids=1 with Accept: application/json and no token. Trimmed to the fields Mynou reads and a few it ignores; a public film, no account data. The same request for other items was refused without a token (metadata-without-token.json), so Mynou sends the owner's token to the discover provider, where Plex Web opens an item's /library/metadata key. That provider's 200 answer is taken to have this shape: to check with a live account.
